summary: IZEA Worldwide, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, regarding entry into a 10b5-1 repurchase agreement with Ladenburg Thalmann & Co. Inc. The agreement authorizes open-market or privately negotiated repurchases of up to $8.6 million of IZEA's common stock, representing the remaining balance under a previously disclosed $10 million share repurchase program. As of May 15, 2026, 523,268 shares had been repurchased for $1.3247 million. Purchases may begin May 18, 2026, and terminate by November 13, 2026, or earlier upon completion or other events. The plan is conducted under Rule 10b5-1 and 10b-18 safe harbor. What to watch: execution pace and market impact; risk-arb angle limited as this is a routine buyback, not a tender offer.
